The leader (Diversified Miners) is NOT trend-gate eligible, while the highest-eligibility themes are High-Dividend Blue Chips, Conglomerates & Exchange, Energy, and Property & REITs — all showing trend/mixed-trend texture. theses.thesis: This is the most durable trend-gate eligible theme in the ranks (durability_bar 0.81, highest among eligibles), with trend hurst_tag, full breadth (1.0), and zero crowding. The detector's one validated edge — the absolute-trend gate — supports staying with this name over non-eligible leaders like Diversified Miners, even though its momentum score is mid-pack (0.542, rank 5). The lean is a trend-discipline continuation call, not a momentum call.
